facts.text: The user has a premium men's undershirt brand.
The user has a machine learning model that identified concepts associated with the premium men's undershirt brand.
The user provided a list of concepts with index scores and asked to remove concepts likely unrelated.
The user asked for the original list with unrelated concepts removed.
The user said the men's undershirt brand is catered toward the high end of the market.
The user asked which other concepts to recommend getting rid of given the brand is high end.
The user asked for the list again with those removed.
The user asked for a short narrative about each remaining topic and how a consumer might be interested in these topics for undershirt research or evaluation.
